notes.title: Register for the Open Beta Test here!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44717532/8710c8b5653b6157d00458eeb2a581621c854978.png[/img]
Hello Runners, this is the Brazen Blaze management team.
Following on the heels of the extremely successful Closed Alpha Test, the Open Beta Test will be available for SteamVR, and will take place from February 5, 2024 to February 12, 2024 (PST). Registrations open today.

[b]Register for the Open Beta Test from link below:[/b]
[url=https://mydearesthub.com/signup?title_id=400&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam]OBT Registration
[/url]
*If you already have a MyDearest HUB account, you are registered for the Open Beta Test. An email will be sent out before the test explaining how to join.

[b][What’s New]〓─〓─〓〓─〓─〓〓─〓─〓[/b]
[b]1. New Character[/b]
In addition to the 3 characters that were playable in the Closed Alpha Test  - the punk Riot, the bounty hunter Skybolt and the CEO Legacy - the Open Beta Test will feature a brand new fourth character: Velvet, a speed type character wielding a katana. A movie celebrity, Velvet is determined to cut her way to fame!

[b]2. Ranked Match System[/b]
A system that matches players with similar skill levels has been implemented. The more you win, the stronger the opponents you'll face. Aim to be at the top among all players!

[b]3. New Sub Weapon[/b]
“Shake Grenade” that explodes bigger the more you shake it, and “Combat Knife” that will be your go to weapon for melee combat,  will be added to the roster of sub weapons.
Do you have what it takes to use these weapons to their full potential?
[b]〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓─〓 [/b]

Check out the Brazen Blaze Official Standalone Website for details on the Runners and lore!
https://brazenblaze.com

notes.title: VR Multiplayer Game Announcement!

Hello, this is the MyDearest team.

We want to announce Project: Gathering, our first multiplayer endeavor, to you!

notes.title: A free comic with the ALTDEUS characters!
notes.content:
Big announcement!

We want to let you know about the new content for ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos! 
A new DLC? Nope! Skins for the game? Double nope!
A free comic with the ALTDEUS characters!

Chronos Chillax!!! Every Tuesday on our Discord server, Chronos Haven!! 

We are always thinking about how to bring new content to you, the fans of the series. We usually bring to the table many ideas, most of them too ambitious but this series, Chronos Chillax, it's a good way to keep enjoying the fun universe of ALTDEUS after playing the game.

Chronos Chillax is not going to follow the serious tone of the game, as I think you guessed by its name, so let this comic brighten your day! 
Every week, every Tuesday, a new comic. Drink your daily cup of coffee or tea and stop reading the news for a moment, just take 20 seconds of your day for Chronos Chillax and your mood will change in the most positive way! 
Chronos Chillax, sport, and a healthy diet, are the 3 keys to a long life! Come to Discord and enjoy!

Discord server: https://discord.gg/mqZfH8AvG5

notes.title: DLC ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO is out on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the MyDearest team.

We’re pleased to announce that a new DLC of ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO is finally out now on Steam!

It was initially released for Oculus Quest / Oculus Quest 2 in June.
Thank you for your patience in waiting for the Steam version for such a long time.

Like the Oculus Quest version, the Steam version features English and Japanese voice acting and Chinese (Simplified), and French subtitles.

In the new DLC, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos EPISODE YAMATO, you play as Second Lieutenant Yamato Amanagi, a member of Prometheus and pilot of the Ares Makhia. The Swordstrike system, the awesome power of Ares Makhia's sword, provides you with new interactive experiences, taking approximately 2 hours to complete all of the story branches.

We’re pretty confident that the effects and the interactivity in the DLC are further enhanced from the main story’s.

We hope you’ll enjoy being Yamato! 

Best regards,

The MyDearest Team

notes.title: ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos has received the Famitsu Platinum Hall of Fame
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos has received the Famitsu Platinum Hall of Fame. 

Famitsu is the most prestigious video game magazine starting in 1986 in Japan.
They review new games released in Japan every week.
If the average scores of 4 reviewers are 9 or more out of 10, a game receives the Famitsu Platinum Hall of Fame.

They’ve recently reviewed ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos according to the physical package released in Japan.
As a result, ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos has received the Famitsu Platinum Hall of Fame.

We’re honored to have received it.

We're happy to hear your feedback on the review too.

Thank you for your continued support.

The MyDearest Team
